artifact_precedence: frozen experiment result JSON or compact result table
conversation memory only as a locator, never as final evidence
source_snapshot.snapshot_rule: Mutable authoritative summaries are read from starting_checkpoint with git show; detailed tracked artifacts must have their blob identity recorded in the evidence manifest.

include: completed pre-2024 A-share outcome-bearing experiments with explicit closure, null, mixed, unstable, defensive, failed-transfer, or no-useful-information decisions
named price-limit lifecycle and reopen-reseal acceptance states
named Low Idio, Low Vol-of-Vol, Low Skewness defensive families
named RS Acceleration veto and Champion Confirmed-Breakdown exit translation
scientifically incomplete Cross-Sectional Dispersion translation as an unresolved control
other family-level closed results with sufficient compact artifacts and a recoverable original direction
exclude: outcome-blind representation construction without an economic-response claim
pure engineering attempts superseded by a completed scientific retry
current frozen Strategy A construction and successful components except as already-used controls
the fully audited Downside Resilience and Shock Absorption/Recovery sequence except as a methodological reference
raw-panel recomputation, full-market rebuilds, strategy replay, and new parameter or outcome research
scope.family_consolidation: Multiple experiments testing the same mechanism and decision role are consolidated into one family row; materially different mechanisms inside a batch may receive separate rows when the authoritative artifacts provide separate directional conclusions.
scope.inventory_count_rule: TOTAL_EXPERIMENTS_INVENTORIED counts distinct experiment IDs inspected, including reference-only and unresolved experiments; TOTAL_FAMILIES_AUDITED counts consolidated rows assigned one of the six audit classes.

audit_classifications.TRUE_NULL: Economically tiny, noisy, incoherent across horizons/periods/definitions, or without reliable opposite structure.
audit_classifications.CHRONOLOGICALLY_UNSTABLE: Meaningful effect reverses materially across fixed chronological blocks or years and neither leg has a separately stable interpretable structure.
audit_classifications.STABLE_ADVERSE_ALREADY_USED: The original direction failed or exposed adverse information, and that information was already incorporated into an accepted decision, preserved component, explicit non-action, or frozen lifecycle interpretation.
audit_classifications.STABLE_ADVERSE_LONG_CANDIDATE_NEEDS_ANAT: Existing artifacts suggest the opposite long leg itself may have positive absolute or relative payoff, but its standalone leg/baseline decomposition has not been completed.
audit_classifications.STABLE_ADVERSE_AVOIDANCE_CANDIDATE_NEEDS: The originally favored group appears intrinsically and stably adverse enough to justify a later negative-leg anatomy, but no strategy or veto is authorized.
audit_classifications.SCIENTIFICALLY_UNRESOLVED: Resource, data-contract, pipeline, sample, or pre-outcome failure prevented a scientific conclusion.

required: economically meaningful adverse magnitude at the family's natural horizon or decision role
same adverse direction across both fixed development blocks when block evidence exists
broad horizon, parameter, year, or distribution support when those diagnostics exist
a comparison against zero, event/sample baseline, PIT industry, broad market, matched control, or executable baseline
the adverse interpretation is not already invalidated by an available leg decomposition
stable_adverse_criteria.minimum_evidence_rule: At least three independent consistency dimensions among horizon, parameter, chronology, year, distribution, and baseline must support the adverse interpretation; chronology is mandatory when reported.
stable_adverse_criteria.economic_materiality_guide: As a guide rather than a search threshold: at least 20 bp at a natural short/medium return horizon, at least 2 percentage points in a severe-loss/risk diagnostic, or a material executable portfolio delta. Tiny effects remain null even with repeated signs.
stable_adverse_criteria.missing_diagnostic_rule: Unavailable diagnostics are marked UNKNOWN, never imputed as favorable evidence.

spread_decomposition.true_opposite_long: Opposite leg is itself positive in absolute and/or PIT-relative terms, not merely above the original leg.
spread_decomposition.avoidance_only: Originally favored leg is materially negative versus zero/baseline while the opposite leg is ordinary or unknown.
spread_decomposition.less_bad_only: Both legs are weak/negative and the opposite leg only loses less.
spread_decomposition.relative_only: A stable spread exists without a usable absolute long leg.
spread_decomposition.unknown: Existing compact artifacts do not identify the legs; candidate status must say NEEDS_ANATOMY and may not claim Alpha.

already_used_rule: Includes accepted or preserved veto/admission/ranking/defensive information and a scientifically justified retain/no-exit decision. An already-used finding is not a new candidate.

candidate_priority.formula: Evidence Strength x Economic Magnitude x Stability x New Information / Follow-up Cost
candidate_priority.high: Broad material adverse evidence, chronological agreement, genuinely unexploited decision information, and low-cost anatomy from existing compact artifacts or panels.
candidate_priority.medium: Credible adverse topology with one important missing decomposition/stability diagnostic or moderate follow-up cost.
candidate_priority.low: Weak magnitude, incomplete stability, relative-only potential, or limited decision headroom.

required_outputs: compact candidate table capped at three
Research OS state and portfolio updates
